We’ve all had that moment: it’s late, the deadline is tomorrow, and your draft looks like a disaster. Most students fall into the 54% trap, but you don't have to.

THE 54% TRAP: Copy-pasting AI summaries at 3 AM that hallucinate citations, or hiring unverified freelancers who miss deadlines and leave you empty-handed. This is how you end up with a red Turnitin band and a grade that doesn't reflect your potential.

THE 78% BLUEPRINT: 
• Focus on the rubric first—it’s the marker’s grading key.
• Use verified, peer-reviewed sources that actually support your argument.
• Structure your logic before you type a single word.
• Get support from experts who know exactly what your department looks for.
